name: CI Gz Physics

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # run daily at midnight UTC

jobs:
  build_and_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Dart repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install build tools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake git

      - name: Build and install Dart
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          cmake --build build -- -j$(nproc)
          sudo cmake --install build

      - name: Clone gz-physics repository
        run: |
          git clone https://github.com/gazebosim/gz-physics.git
          cd gz-physics
          git fetch --tags
          TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
          git checkout $TAG

      - name: Build gz-physics
        run: |
          cd gz-physics
          mkdir -p build
          cmake -S . -B build \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
            -DGZ_PHYSICS_BUILD_TESTS=ON \
            -DGZ_PHYSICS_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF \
            -DGZ_PHYSICS_BUILD_DOCS=OFF \
            -DGZ_PHYSICS_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=OFF \
            -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/usr/local
          cmake --build build -- -j$(nproc)

      - name: Run gz-physics tests
        run: |
          cd gz-physics/build
          ctest --output-on-failure
